purpose: Research/provenance only. Exact nearby model cases remain visible; no live-model parity inferred from detached inspection.

selection.unit: All shape-base identity/name/placeholder-format cases; shape-tree title lookup, sequence/index/count and keyed placeholder lookup cases, including every collected parameter variant.
selection.bdd: All expanded shape name/id examples, shape collection sequence scenarios, title lookup and title-slide text assignment.
selection.excluded: Chart/axis titles and core document title/description are different resources; generated shape IDs/names and placeholder cloning are creation behavior unchanged here. Geometry/style/text editing remains in existing ledgers.
selection.directAccessibilityCases: No collected unit/BDD case names describe alt text or decorative flags. The one description match is dc:description core comments, not drawing metadata. F52 requires original format/security cases.
